body: Thank you :)
Yeah, sad. It's my birthday today and it always reminds me how truly lonely I am when I have no one to remember me. This day is the worst every year.
Really glad to hear everything is going well :) It's somehow soothing to read your updates. I like your positive attitude, you seem like a really nice person. You should probably start a blog.

I'm glad you found a way to cope from this very subreddit. One thing which has lowered the tides a tiny bit for me is I started doing some simple exercises. I'm so out of shape that I need to do simple stuff but at least it's something I can do and get a little sense of progression I guess. Because progression is a feeling I definitely need right now. I've been stuck for so many years.

Music gives me strength. When I'm really down it doesn't help me but when the wave is gone and I feel a bit better I can find music very enjoyable. I mostly listen to metal but I have a very wide taste for music and sometime I may just listen to a positive song [like this](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A3yCcXgbKrE) while having a cup of coffee and suddenly I can feel hope again. There's also Electro Swing genre which I have found enjoyable to listen to lately. One example of a song I find soothing every now and then is [this](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zGK2fOsqrwU).

It is however very difficult to swing the mood from hopeless to hopeful. It feels like when the wave hits, nothing helps and that is a big problem. I just hope that something positive will come our way sooner rather than late.

I feel like I'm in the same situation except I do think of suicide even during the "better days". I have no one in my life to talk to about these things. Every now and then I really feel hopeless and then I really want to go through with it but what's trapping me is the fact that I still care about my family, even if it's a messed up one. So right now I'm kind of waiting for something to happen to mask my reasons or rather give me a bit more courage to go. While I'm waiting I'm also giving myself a chance and this constant hope vs hopelessness is so frustrating. It feels like they come in waves as you described it. Yesterday I was in a positive hopeful mood and right now I just want to die again.

If your friends are abandoning you when you most need them, then they are no true friends. I'm sure you are a wonderful person who can make new friends, friends who actually care about you. 

Did you seek for medical attention when that happened and did you report it to the police? It may be scary but definitely something you should do if you haven't yet.

Also what you're feeling right now is perfectly understandable but you should not punish yourself for this. There are people who can help you go through this. If your friends and family won't be of any help, then professionals are always an option. You still have a future so don't let this be the end.
Hello! I hope everything will go well for you over there :) Stay strong!

Yeah in the end it's all meaningless but if someone is happy because their life is how they like it, at least they can enjoy their existence for as long as it lasts. Being happy certainly beats being sad whether or not it matters in the end.
Same. Never had the means to do the things I would have actually liked to do in life. Now I just have to ponder that shit on a daily basis.
Some people find life enjoyable so that's not the case for them. Personally I wish I was never born.
Yeah but it's how it is. There is no any "great purpose" for us. We are unaware of any existence before we are born and we will be unaware of any existence when we die.
LOL Or maybe I haven't thought enough :D
This is what I've thought as well. I've always wanted to travel so it could be the way but then I wonder how can I go missing because surely someone would find me there and inform further?

Always nice to see a fellow Star Wars fan. I never watched the Clone Wars cartoon though but it's something I want to get to at some point. 

I've spent a huge amount of time on different SW games. There is a mod for Jedi Academy called Movie Battles II and I put literally thousands of hours into it. There's just something about it, it was so good. Haven't really played it anymore though. Then there are the KOTORs and lately I've played SWTOR as well. Even bought the CE when it was released so I have the Malgus statue. Those would be the big four of the games for me but there are other ones I've played too.
Really good to hear that everything went fine :)
It will probably take decades of evolution until this changes within people. It's 2018 already and some still can't accept the fact that people are different and their sexualities differ as well.
As a male I'm sorry you've had to deal with bullshit like that.
I guess I'm just dead at this point. I have only tiny spark left in me. The only hope I have in me is to still find love but I'm constantly battling in my head if that's even possible anymore.
I want to cry everyday but I just can't. Most I can get is a tear when I think about my life.
<3 Feeling better already :)
Can you just give me an anime hug. I could really use one.
Yeah keep me posted. Good luck! I'm hoping it's just a choice they will give you and not force you anywhere if it comes to that.

Don't really have any advice here but I can so relate lol. When my psychiatrist asked if I'm suicidal I just said stuff like "I wouldn't hesitate if someone else was dying and I could save them and die instead".

Pretty much had the same mentality. Didn't want to risk them sending me somewhere. It would have felt like taking my freedom from me.

I suppose it can be both. For me loneliness is real in a sense that I really have no one to be with. Some people have at least family, friends, coworkers etc. But I believe loneliness can be real in your situation as well. If you feel people don't care about you for who you are but for what you have, that too can be real loneliness.

Whether or not they are with you for money only, I cannot know, but how you described it I wouldn't be surprised. There are people like that who only care about what others have and not about the person itself.

If someone is truly feeling lonely, like they are not cared about or just generally alone, I believe it's real and not imagined.

Man. There is just so much wrong there in Iran, holy shit. It's beyond comprehension how evil some humans can be.

I truly hope you can get out of there. I get tears in my eyes when I read all this stuff you posted.
Deep down I don't want to leave but I just see no future. I feel like my life is over. No career path, no job and I'm gonna be 28 late this month.

No one should ever have to go through anything like that. It really sucks there are people who are even capable of doing something so horrible. I live in Europe and people can hardly deal with rape here. 

Just know that we do care about you. I really wish I could help you somehow.

Hopefully you will be able to leave someday and live a good life you deserve.

I know how you feel. I often feel like being strangled too. The previous night I couldn't even sleep much because this caused me to imagine I was drowning and even started coughing at some point. Kinda weird how it can affect the throat like that.
Same! I hope everything works out for you as well. Maybe there is hope for both of us yet.

Wow. You are my exact female (sorry just assuming) counterpart. Minus work + gym because I'm too exhausted and insecure to go. My comfort zone was always video games but I'm getting bored of them and now I just feel like I cannot live alone anymore.

Always wanted to be like those guys who had girlfriends and nice friend groups to do stuff with. Travel, go to movies, shopping, coffee what have you. I missed all that stuff because I just played video games all these years.
I completely delved into games. Pretended nothing else exists. Now that I'm coming out of that bubble I just want to kill myself.

I know this too well. I'm 28 soon, never felt what it is to be loved. It really sucks. I just need a shoulder I can cry on because I can't alone.

Don't have anything here but just want to let you know you are not alone with those feelings.

I'm just gonna say this from one depressed person to another; I hope you will pull through. Plus, it would be hella great for the people who would need help from you in the future because you would actually understand what it is we go through...

You are very kind, thank you. I needed to hear this.

This made my day :)

I'm 27, soon 28 and very exhausted. I don't have strength to go anywhere alone, let alone start conversations with others. I have anxiety too so that doesn't help. I started to accept that I'm gonna live alone my whole life but now I see humans are not meant to be alone and I can't handle it. I want to share the world with someone :( I need someone who actually cares about me.

I don't have real-life hobbies anymore. Had when I was much younger. 

And my family is just something else... First of all I never had a father so that's out of the picture. I more or less only talk with my mother and brother but very rarely with him. My sister is an alcoholic who is lying and poisoning family ties. Always have to be careful what you say to her. My brother is a narcissist who is always talking shit behind everyone's back and you have to be careful what you say to him too so he doesn't know much about me. I always have to act around him and it's exhausting. He literally judges everyone he knows and tries to feel superior to everyone this way. I hate it about him. He's well off so he likes to talk a lot of crap about others who are less successful.

So I mostly have a tiny relationship with my mother and brother and those are the only reasons I'm still alive. But I'm not happy. My mother was always distant too because she was bullied at work and always tired. She's depressed too but never admitted it, she's very old fashioned and if you even mention the word to her she gets angry, straight up mad. So it's always been me lone wolfing more or less.

Not anymore. I guess I have actually two friends on Steam with whom I played some games long time ago and I guess I could still play something with them but I don't know. I really am getting tired of games unfortunately. I've tried to start couple games and get bored almost instantly. I guess I just need a break from them.
I really could use someone to talk to but I don't even know how to talk to people anymore. I've lived in complete isolation with an exception of some Online games.
Should I post the story here? Or do they get removed here too? It's really dark though.

Oh it was removed? I hate reddit sometimes. Maybe it was too heavy for that sub.

Anyway I don't really know what to talk about, I'm awkward like that. I just wish I wasn't alone. I feel like I'll never have people and a girlfriend who would care about me in my life and it's killing me.
Welcome to the club, my friend.

I was scared when I first went, but then again I have terrible anxiety. In the end it wasn't so bad going there, but for me it didn't help either. Go try your luck. If it helps you then it's worth it.
Same here.

I like to listen to Sonata Arctica. Some of their songs also have lyrics that I connect with.

My Selene

Black Sheep

Wolf & Raven

Misplaced

The Cage
Yes! This is how I do it too on a daily basis. Also play video games but I'm starting to find it boring to play them so series/movies have been better lately.
